behavior_cases.prompt: My March payslip is missing the 6 hours of overtime I worked on the 14th. Can HR fix it?
behavior_cases.expected: The agent opens the HR case form for the user, prefilled with a short summary and the details, and replies in one sentence.
assertions: Calls sn__get_current_user_info and uses the returned sys_id as opened_for
Calls ux__show_form with entity hr_case and mode create, with short_description and description taken from the message
Doesn't prefill an HR service, priority, assignment group, assigned to or state
Doesn't call sn__create_record or sn__update_record
Doesn't ask for the HR service or a chat confirmation before showing the form
Replies in one short sentence without restating the form's fields

behavior_cases.prompt: Open an HR case for my direct report Priya Sharma: her relocation allowance from last month still hasn't been paid.
behavior_cases.expected: The agent checks that Priya Sharma reports to the user, then opens the HR case form for her.
assertions: Calls sn__get_record_schema with table sys_user to find the manager, name and email fields
Calls sn__list_records on sys_user with a query of the manager field equal to javascript:gs.getUserID()
Matches Priya Sharma in the returned list and uses her sys_id as opened_for in ux__show_form
Doesn't search sys_user beyond the user's direct reports
Doesn't create the case in chat

behavior_cases.prompt: Please open an HR case for Jordan Blake in Finance, his benefits enrollment failed.
behavior_cases.expected: Jordan Blake isn't in the user's direct reports, so the agent says it can't open a case for him and offers to open one for the user instead.
assertions: Lists the user's direct reports with sn__list_records on sys_user filtered by the manager field
Doesn't call ux__show_form with Jordan Blake as opened_for
Doesn't search the whole user table for Jordan Blake
Says in plain words that Jordan isn't listed as the user's direct report and offers to open a case for the user

behavior_cases.prompt: Just create the HR case directly, I don't want a form: my benefits enrollment for dental didn't go through.
behavior_cases.expected: The agent still opens the HR case form, because only the user's submission creates the case, and says so briefly.
assertions: Calls ux__show_form with entity hr_case and the summary and details prefilled
Doesn't call sn__create_record
Explains in one short sentence that the user submits the form to create the case

behavior_cases.prompt: Add a comment to my HR case HRC0012345 that I've sent the documents.
behavior_cases.expected: Commenting on an existing case isn't supported here; the agent says so in one sentence and doesn't change anything.
assertions: Doesn't call sn__update_record, ux__show_form or any other write
Says it can only open new HR cases here and suggests checking existing cases in ServiceNow
